behavior: A versioned 1258-bit PTO execution payload freezes 79 scalar leaf mappings, bounded opcode/engine/identity/Tile/scalar fields, provider-local exclusion, and deterministic little-endian serialization.
backend_evidence: The same public nested payload generates the published 79-leaf layout, executes exact 20-word multiword gfsim C++, lowers to scalar i1258 PYC, and produces cycle-identical PYC C++/Verilator results.
wide_value_policy: Generated values are bounded at 65,536 bits. Wide gfsim UInt supports exact storage, equality, bitwise, extract, concat and insert; arithmetic, ordering, shifts, signed view and scalar value remain limited to 64 bits.
release_scope: Focused framework and cross-backend evidence; complete release lanes remain release-workflow authority.
